objective: Repair the demonstrated CKAD20 context-selection limitation by selecting among evidence-derived native hypotheses with new public intervention feedback in the same accumulated checkpoint.
scope: Explicit new synthetic development experiment. Original CKAD20 thresholds and negatives stay fixed. Public session boundary permits a new context belief; neither family nor regime is a learner feature. No original-source actor or protected science.
hypotheses: At each public session start, replay the retained episode ledger into candidates from consecutive disjoint blocks of32 episodes, including final block if >=8 episodes. Candidates use identical existing native representations, selected structures, paired-view projection and native counter repair. Uniform initial candidate weights. During16 probe episodes, multiply each candidate's predicted transition and terminal outcome likelihoods with exact rational Bayes normalization. Candidate weights and observations persist in the full checkpoint; old episode evidence is retained.
acquisition: Active context action maximizes weighted disagreement variance among candidate public forecasts, then proximity of mean to1/2, then0. Select first action, observe S2, select second action, observe delayedY. Random context receives identical16-action-pair episode budget with deterministic hash-random actions. Other trained controls consume exact active-context receipts. New real feedback updates native global bank and the current belief. Dream/planning readout composes belief-weighted transition and terminal forecasts. No dreamed target is trained.
cohorts: Session index0..5 uses ckad21-probe-{session}, index0..15. Held ckad21-held-{session}, index0..95. Same source draws for every arm at seed/session/index, different probe and held namespaces. Session6 terminal_switch is descriptive unfamiliar transfer. Each full trained checkpoint continues through every session, no weight initialization reset.
controls: Independent exact mixture over the same publicly witnessed block models; every probability and decision must tie within exact Fraction arithmetic.
Original pooled native continued on the same active probe outcomes with context readouts disabled.
Fully fitted conventional full-history Beta dynamic program on identical active evidence.
Fixed trailing64-observation MLE on identical active evidence.
Original frozen CKAD20 planner with no probe adaptation as descriptive baseline.
Untrained 1/2 forecasts and fixed00 policy as descriptive baseline.
metrics: Executed held closed-loop terminal reward, transition/terminal and pooled matched-action Brier, all session returns and context weights, confident errors if a threshold is defined (otherwise no confident-error claim), earlier-state byte retention, checkpoint/cold continuation, acquired probe counts, wall/CPU/resource bytes.

success.engineering: Source receipt validation, exact independent mixture parity, full retained knowledge/evidence hashes, checkpoint backward compatibility, all public input negatives, deterministic Linux/Windows, final full regression and independent audit. Preserve any NO_GO as result.
success.development: Across seeds, mean active-context held reward on returning invariant sessions0&3 >=.80 and shifted sessions1&4 >=.80. Returning invariant mean exceeds same-evidence pooled native by>=.05 and is >= trailing64 MLE. Final terminal-switch held performance is descriptive. If any threshold fails DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; no post-result tuning. Exact mixture tie grants no scientific superiority.

classification: Engineering/development external candidate only. scientific_pass=false, accepted_native=false, deployment=NONE. Existing draft PR1207; no merge/promotion, controller/scheduler/owner mutation or disruption of independent research.
